_comment: Five-task XR-1 recoverability-ladder pilot, schema 2. See docs/recoverability_ladder.md. The v1 (schema 1) config is in git history at b7f1f6d6 and frozen in the v1 run's plan.json.
_expected_success_rates_source: XR-1 natural-rate 50-rollout selections in docs/safe_xiaomi_dense_subtask.md (success/50); all inside 20-80% and all with curated ordered predicates
_exclude_predicates_source: audit-predicates on the v1 pilot (docs/recoverability_ladder_pilot_20261016.md, problem A): CuttingToolSelection drawer_open was the first stage to latch only at success in 7/7 successful parents (drawer starts 27-30% open, is_open needs 0.90); ArrangeBreadBasket cabinet_open in 4/9. Ladder-level only; eval_composite_predicates.py is unchanged.
_planning_anchor_source: expected_detection_fraction / expected_stage_entry_fraction: medians over v1 failed parents of the schema-2 stage-overdue detector replayed on v1 progress events with a v1 calibration (in-sample, approximate). Replace with plan --reference-run on the naturals run.
_max_budget_steps_source: ArrangeBreadBasket H=4350 is 2.5x its longest v1 natural success (1727 steps from reset); 2200 steps keeps every branch longer than any observed full success and brings the expected cost to about two 24 h allocations. Remove to use the full remaining horizon (about one more allocation).
